messages:
lina: heads up - started seeing a cluster of nodes in rack rk-12 failing to finish boot after last night's BIOS+FW stage. boot sequence stalls at 'keystore init' then drops to serial console spam. noticed MTU errors on the top-of-rack and a small burst of pps from mgmt network.
ajay: which FW image did we deploy to rk-12?
eli: 2026-03-19-rtm-bios-v3 + bmc-2026-03-19-a1. rollout was staged last night, canary passed on two racks.
lina: canary looked fine but these nodes show keystore lag + ip fragments piling up, NIC queues hit 100% -> kernel starts rx-dropped -> management plane evicts GPU leases. GPU capacity down ~18% in eu-west-1.
sre-oncall: ops-bot reports 7 eviction events and 12 provisioning timeouts between 02:00-02:12 UTC. ticket INF-8732 created. linking logs.
ops-bot: ALERT: GPU_POOL:eu-west-1 reduced capacity by 18% (7 nodes evicted). See /incidents/INF-8732. :warning:
kev: can we pause the rest of the firmware rollout? if this is keystore timing-related, we should stop.
eli: pausing now, hold queue for any rack-level staged groups. I'll push a config knob to disable the keystore async on next boot for the next batch.
maria: we should consider a targeted rollback of the BMC image on rk-12 only. reapplying older bmc made a similar cluster stable last quarter.
ajay: agree with rollback for rk-12. we need to avoid global rollback because of cost/ops.
eli: running the rollback plan on rk-12 now. command: ```./fleetctl reboot --rack rk-12 --image bmc-2026-02-10-stable && ./fleetctl verify --rack rk-12 --check bootseq,keystore,nic```
lina: FYI the evictions caused higher on-demand fallback to hosted capacity for some prod tenants, cost spike estimate ~+$1.2k for the window. tagging finance.
kev: can we quarantine the affected nodes from autoscaler so they don't get new jobs while we triage?
sre-oncall: quarantine applied. scaling policies adjusted to respect reserved capacity for dedicated customers.
maria: after rollback, we should run an end-to-end boot with mtu=9000 and mtu=1500 to see if fragmentation behavior changes. also collect kernel logs: ```journalctl -k -b -1 | grep -i mtu```
eli: logs show repeated "NET_RX_DROP: skb->len > mtu" followed by BMC serial retransmit attempts. suspect BMC firmware changed behavior for mgmt NIC offload.
ajay: next steps: 1) rollback rk-12 BMC, 2) pause remaining rack group rollouts, 3) run targeted canary with offload disabled, 4) postmortem + cost delta.
lina: doing a quick headcount of impacted tenants and owners, will send alerts in a sec.
ops-bot: NOTE: Rollback job started by eli at 2026-03-20T02:25:00Z for rk-12.
maria: if rollback stabilizes but MTU issue persists, we should open a vendor escalation with NIC firmware vendor (vendor-ticket VEND-4012).
eli: rollback finished for rk-12, reboot sequence completes cleanly on 6/7 nodes, one node still in serial spam - digging.
kev: great, pause the rest of the rollout indefinitely until we confirm the full validation checklist. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: marking INF-8732 as high-priority and scheduling follow-up call in 30 mins.
lina: thanks team. will capture the short triage notes and the initial RCA draft for the postmortem.
ops-bot: REMINDER: Please update INF-8732 with any new mitigation steps.
